item.title: Long TSA lines at San Diego International Airport extend to the street
item.description: Travelers at San Diego International Airport are experiencing long wait times at security checkpoints due to a partial government shutdown affecting TSA employees.

item.title: Family sues city of Chula Vista after 2 killed in crash on Telegraph Canyon Road
item.description: The family of a man who was killed in a crash last August has filed a lawsuit against the City of Chula Vista, saying the city was aware of the dangerous conditions of the specific intersection and did not address safety concerns.

item.title: How to apply for TSA PreCheck and CLEAR amid long airport security lines
item.description: The ongoing government shutdown has caused a shortage of TSA agents, leading to longer security wait times at airports, but enrolling in programs like TSA PreCheck and CLEAR+ could cut your wait time.

item.title: Mission Beach lifeguard tower closed indefinitely for repairs
item.description: The City of San Diego is repairing the crumbling Mission Beach Lifeguard Tower, which has been fenced off indefinitely, and has built a temporary structure for the lifeguards to use until the repairs are completed by Memorial Day.

item.title: County reviewing contracting process after nonprofit leader alleged of embezzling funds
item.description: San Diego County is reviewing its contracting process following allegations that the former COO of the Harm Reduction Coalition embezzled $6 million in county grant money for personal expenses.

item.title: Kaiser employees ratify new contract after months of negotiations
item.description: Kaiser Permanente employees have ratified new contracts after months of negotiations and strikes, resulting in better wages, benefits, labor practices, and staffing ratios.

item.title: Feeding San Diego supports TSA agents during government shutdown
item.description: Feeding San Diego is providing food assistance to TSA agents impacted by the partial government shutdown, as many workers go weeks without pay.

item.title: California Assembly passes bill to rename Cesar Chavez Day
item.description: The California Assembly voted unanimously to establish Farmworkers Day.

item.title: Bear cub brothers to be raised in San Diego County after mother's euthanization
item.description: Two orphaned bear cub brothers are now in the care of a San Diego County wildlife center after their mother was euthanized for posing a public safety threat.

item.title: The Latest: Airport wait times remain high as Congress considers a partial DHS funding deal
item.description: Senators are discussing a proposal to end the Homeland Security budget stalemate by funding much of the department, including Transportation Security Administration airport workers who are going without pay. The deal would exclude U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement's removal operations, which have been core to the dispute. As U.S. airports remain jammed with long lines [...]
